statuses.label: Functional
statuses.description: Works for its intended use; fidelity to the original is not claimed.

statuses.label: Faithful
statuses.description: Matches the original game's behavior as traced.

statuses.label: Validated
statuses.description: Faithful or complete, and covered by passing tests.

statuses.label: Blocked
statuses.description: Cannot progress until something else is resolved.

statuses.label: Unknown
statuses.description: Status not established or not verified.

method: Percentages are shares of registered features: 'functional or better' counts the functional, faithful and validated statuses declared in the registries; 'passing tests' counts features whose declared tests all passed when this data was generated. Unregistered work is not counted.

features.title: Samus animation and palette reconstruction
features.limitations: The deterministic private library maps the currently supported semantic actions; native effects and every pose are not yet covered.
features.next_action: Extend coverage to native effects and the remaining poses.

features.title: Samus and room Clipdata collision
features.limitations: Room Clipdata and the Samus collision subset are active; special blocks and all environmental effects remain incomplete.
features.next_action: Port special blocks and environmental Clipdata effects.

features.title: Keyboard and gamepad input
features.limitations: Host input layer: SDL3 devices are mapped to the GBA KEYINPUT bits; the native key reading and repeat logic are not ported. Hot-plugged SDL3 gamepads, a remappable GBA layout and the keyboard drive Samus; no in-game controls menu yet.
features.next_action: Port the native input routines and add an in-game controls menu.

features.title: Samus pose and physics controller
features.limitations: The room runtime covers a tested subset of poses and transitions, not the complete native controller.
features.next_action: Port the remaining native pose handlers.

features.title: Doors, hatches and room transitions
features.limitations: Room-runtime door travel and hatch animation are partial; native fades, locks, events and lifecycle are not complete.
features.next_action: Port native fades, hatch locks and door lifecycle events.

features.title: Beam and missile projectiles
features.limitations: Power Beam, missiles and super missiles are represented; the complete beam, bomb and Power Bomb systems are not.
features.next_action: Port the remaining beam, bomb and Power Bomb systems.

features.title: Soma death state
features.limitations: Soma's death state is ported; game-over flow, restart and save integration are absent.
features.next_action: Port the native game-over flow and its save integration.

features.title: Bat enemy
features.limitations: Bat hanging, swoop, combat and falling death are ported; its explosion particles and the global 0x8E & 0x40 state are not.
features.next_action: Port the bat explosion particles and its special state.

features.title: Blue crow enemy
features.limitations: ArcTan2 follows the mGBA high-level BIOS polynomial, not checked against the BIOS itself. Perching, the homing flight behind the player and the falling death are ported; the feathers, sounds, hit stun and the unentered glide step are not.
features.next_action: Port the crow feathers of sub_080C9E2C and the hit stun of sub_0806AD24.

features.title: Zombie and generic enemy death
features.limitations: Zombie spawning, terrain walking and generic death are covered; the complete enemy framework is not.
features.next_action: Extend the generic enemy framework to further native enemies.

features.title: Native wooden doors
features.limitations: Wooden and green doors are functional in exported rooms; this does not cover every transition or special door.
features.next_action: Cover the remaining native transition and special door kinds.

features.title: Keyboard and gamepad input
features.limitations: Host input layer: SDL3 devices are mapped to the GBA KEYINPUT bits; the native key reading and repeat logic are not ported. Hot-plugged SDL3 gamepads, a remappable GBA layout and the keyboard drive Soma; no in-game controls menu yet.
features.next_action: Port the native input routines and add an in-game controls menu.

features.title: Soma movement and state controller
features.limitations: Movement and the currently traced ability states are ported; the full native player state machine is not complete.
features.next_action: Port the remaining native Soma states.

features.title: Soma weapon entity and attack boxes
features.limitations: Weapon classes 0, 2 and 3 are represented; the other native classes and their effects remain open.
features.next_action: Port the remaining native weapon classes and effects.

features.title: Per-character state kept across switches
features.limitations: Deferred.

features.title: Switching between Samus and Soma
features.limitations: Deferred until both original reconstructions are complete (ROADMAP).

features.title: Both engines hosted in one game process
features.limitations: Each game runs in its own executable today.

features.title: Cross-world event orchestration
features.limitations: Deferred.

features.title: Editor overlays applied by the runtimes
features.limitations: The runtimes do not read editor overrides yet.

features.title: Interactions and synergies between both worlds
features.limitations: Deferred.

features.title: Portals and transitions between the worlds
features.limitations: Portal scenes exist only as story data.

features.title: Story bible and canon
features.limitations: Design document; nothing is playable.

features.title: Crossover cutscene scripts
features.limitations: Scripts exist as data; no cutscene runtime exists.

features.title: Concurrent campaign timeline data
features.limitations: Validated data model only; no runtime reads it.

features.title: F1 debug menu in both runtimes
features.limitations: No equipment, soul, flag or AI inspection yet.

features.title: Story, event and cutscene data editor
features.limitations: No native cutscene runtime exists.

features.title: GTK4 map editor workspace
features.limitations: Aria reconstruction in the editor is partial.

features.title: Native source inventory and parity checklist
features.limitations: Lexical analysis: dynamic dispatch and runtime evidence are not indexed.

features.title: Incremental reconstruction graph
features.limitations: Room previews, audits and editor caches are not registered yet.

features.title: Native room tile painter with private overrides
features.limitations: Edits are private overrides; runtimes do not apply them yet.

features.title: Native room and room package viewers
Sprite editor
features.limitations: Sprite previews exist; editing does not.

features.title: Global maps and the Zero Mission world atlas
features.limitations: Shows original minimap cases, not complete world geometry.

features.title: Aria object and enemy sprites, boxes and stats
features.limitations: Only objects and enemies whose create routine is traced (wooden door, bat, zombie, blue crow).

features.title: Aria runtime rooms (background, BG1 collision, transitions, entities)
features.limitations: 342 of 343 rooms export; one has no decodable BG1 collision table. The background is a static composite.

features.title: Soma animation library
features.limitations: One-shot animations use their own palette bank instead of the previous one.

features.title: Soma weapon records and blade sprites
features.limitations: Blades of classes 0, 2 and 3 only.

features.title: Music and sound effects
features.limitations: No audio is decoded or played.

features.title: Zero Mission enemy sprites
features.limitations: An editor sprite cache exists; its use by a runtime is not established.

features.title: Zero Mission runtime rooms (Clipdata, doors, hatches)
features.limitations: 330 of 331 rooms export; the BG1-over-BG2 render is a partial composite.

features.title: Samus body, arm cannon and suit palette library
features.limitations: Needs the reference ELF built from the pinned decompilation.

features.title: Raw ROM import from the pinned decomp databases
features.limitations: Raw blocks are copied, not decoded.

features.title: ROM fingerprint verification
features.limitations: Only the USA revisions are supported.

features.title: Offline dashboard in Firefox, Chromium and Edge
features.limitations: Checked by a static test; not exercised in every browser.

features.title: Linux (Debian 13) build and tests
features.limitations: Verified when the dashboard data is generated on Linux with --run-tests.

features.title: Windows build and runtime
features.limitations: Never compiled or run on Windows.
